english.meaning: added after a verb to show the action succeeded in reaching its goal, as in 揾着 (found it)
english.note: 瞓唔着 means can't fall asleep. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Exactly. You picked the two people you know least to record this.
exampleSentences.traditional: 咪係囖。你揾着兩個最唔熟嘅來錄音噉樣。
